question: Which of the following is the compound with the chemical formula H₂SO₄?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sulfuric Acid**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sulfuric Acid (H₂SO₄)** is a highly corrosive strong acid widely used in industrial processes.
 
• It is commonly known as the "king of chemicals" due to its extensive applications in manufacturing and chemical synthesis.
 
• The chemical formula H₂SO₄ represents two hydrogen (H) atoms, one sulfur (S) atom, and four oxygen (O) atoms.
 
• Sulfuric acid is primarily used in the production of fertilizers, particularly phosphates and ammonium sulfate.
 
• It is also used in petroleum refining, chemical synthesis, wastewater processing, and as an electrolyte in lead-acid batteries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Physical Properties of Sulfuric Acid:**

 
 
• It is a colorless to slightly yellow, odorless, and viscous liquid at room temperature.
 
• Highly soluble in water, but the dilution process is exothermic and must be done with caution.
 
 
 
• **Safety Considerations:**
 
 
• Highly corrosive to metals and tissues; direct contact can cause severe burns.
 
• Proper protective equipment, such as gloves and goggles, is essential when handling sulfuric acid.
 
 
 
• **Other Acids for Comparison:**
 
 
• **Nitric Acid (HNO₃):** Used in fertilizer production and explosives manufacturing.
 
• **Sulfurous Acid (H₂SO₃):** A weaker acid formed in aqueous sulfur dioxide.
 
• **Hydrogen Sulfide (H₂S):** A toxic gas, not an acid, with a characteristic rotten egg smell.
 
 
 
• **Importance in Industry:** Sulfuric acid is a key indicator of a nation's industrial strength due to its critical role in numerous sectors.
